user.title: Chery Connect
user.description: Choose how to sign in to your Omoda/Jaecoo account. Use the phone option if your account is registered with a phone number instead of an email.

login_email.title: Sign in with email
login_email.description: Enter your Omoda/Jaecoo account email and vehicle PIN. An OTP code will be sent to your email; VIN and account ID are detected automatically.{reason}

data.certs_src: Folder with mutual-TLS certs to import (optional)

data_description.preset: Omoda/Jaecoo (Europe) and Chery (Europe) fill in everything automatically. Choose Custom to set the BFF endpoint, tenant code, country/channel IDs, MQTT host and certs by hand for any other region or brand.

login_phone.title: Sign in with phone (SMS)
login_phone.description: Enter the phone number registered on your Omoda/Jaecoo account, its country code (Italy = 39, without +) and the vehicle PIN. A verification code will be sent by SMS; VIN and account ID are detected automatically.{reason}

data.certs_src: Folder with mutual-TLS certs to import (optional)

data_description.preset: Omoda/Jaecoo (Europe) and Chery (Europe) fill in everything automatically. Choose Custom to set the BFF endpoint, tenant code, country/channel IDs, MQTT host and certs by hand for any other region or brand.

otp.title: Verification code
otp.description: Enter the OTP code you received (by email or SMS).{reason}

select_vehicle.title: Select vehicle
select_vehicle.description: Your account has more than one vehicle. Choose the VIN to add.

reconfigure.title: Change settings
reconfigure.description: What do you want to correct? Each option only asks for what it changes: changing how you receive the code will not ask for your PIN.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Chery Connect
reauth_confirm.description:
The session has expired: until you re-authenticate, the integration cannot talk to the car and commands and sensors stay frozen.

**No code has been sent automatically.** Choose “Send me a new code” to have a fresh one sent to {email}.{reason}

menu_options.enter_code: I already have a valid code
menu_options.install_fallback: Install the fallback TLS client (download, ~12 MB)

enter_code.title: Enter the verification code
enter_code.description: Enter the code just sent to {email}. Codes expire after a few minutes: if it is rejected you can go back and request a new one.{reason}

reconfigure_pin.title: Vehicle control PIN
reconfigure_pin.description: Enter the 4-digit PIN used for remote commands. The PIN is not used to sign in, so no verification code is needed here. Fix it if commands come back as "successful" but the car does nothing.

reconfigure_email.title: Receive the code by email
reconfigure_email.description:
The verification code will be sent to this address from now on. Use this if your account is registered with an email address, or to correct a typo.

Your current session stays valid: only the next code changes route.

reconfigure_phone.title: Receive the code by SMS
reconfigure_phone.description:
The verification code will be sent to this number from now on. Write the number without the country code, and the country code as digits only (Italy = 39, no +).

Your current session stays valid: only the next code changes route. If the number is not the one registered with your Omoda/Jaecoo account the SMS will not arrive — you can switch back to email from this same menu.

login_password.title: Sign in with password
login_password.description: Enter your account email, password and vehicle PIN — no OTP code needed. VIN and account ID are detected automatically. The password is used once to sign in and is never stored.{reason}

data.certs_src: Folder with mutual-TLS certs to import (optional)

data_description.preset: Omoda/Jaecoo (Europe) and Chery (Europe) fill in everything automatically. Choose Custom to set the BFF endpoint, tenant code, country/channel IDs, MQTT host and certs by hand for any other region or brand.

reauth_password.title: Re-enter your password
reauth_password.description: The session expired. Enter the account password for {email} to sign back in — no code needed.{reason}

error.otp_send_failed: Could not send the code. Check the email/phone and PIN and try again.
error.no_vehicle: Signed in, but this account has no vehicles. If your car is registered under a different login (e.g. your email address), sign in with that one instead.
error.phone_invalid: That phone number does not look right. Enter the digits of the number only, without the country code and without spaces; in the other field put only the digits of the country code (Italy = 39).
error.email_invalid: That email address does not look right.

abort.token_move_failed: Could not store the authentication token. Check Home Assistant's config folder permissions and try again.
abort.reconfigure_no_entry: Integration not found — reload Home Assistant and try again.
abort.reconfigure_successful: PIN updated. The integration was reloaded.
abort.reauth_no_entry: Integration not found — reload Home Assistant and try again.
abort.reauth_successful: Re-authentication successful. The integration was reloaded.

pin.title: Fix the vehicle control PIN
pin.description: Remote commands are being rejected because the 4-digit control PIN is wrong (the sensors keep working — this is not a login problem). Enter the correct PIN. Do not keep retrying with a wrong PIN, to avoid locking the Chery account.

abort.entry_not_found: Integration not found — reload Home Assistant and try again.

entity_ids_renamed.title: Omoda 9: {count} entities were renamed
entity_ids_renamed.description:
The entity ids of this integration moved from Italian to English: `sensor.omoda9_batteria` is now `sensor.chery_connect_battery`, and {count} entities on this vehicle were renamed.

**Your history came with them.** Graphs, long-term statistics and the energy dashboard followed the rename automatically. There is nothing to reinstall and nothing to log in to again.

**What did not follow: names you typed yourself.** Automations, scripts, template sensors and dashboard cards that refer to an entity by name still point at the old one. Home Assistant shows those as unknown entities.

Where to look: Settings, Automations and scenes, then any automation flagged with an unknown entity. The full old-to-new list is here: {url}

Dismiss this notice once you have been through them.

init.title: Omoda 9 — automatic updates
init.description: How often to wake the car and refresh telemetry + GPS position. 0 = disabled. The charging interval is used while the car is plugged in (telemetry refreshes more often to follow the charge).

data.poll_charging_min: Update interval while plugged in (minutes, 0 = off)
data.vehicle_name: Vehicle name (leave empty to use the name detected from the car)
